name: Limitorque Corporation
old_description: Since 1929, Limitorque actuators have been making flow control easier among a broad range of applications. These actuators are world-class devices used to consistently drive multi-turn and quarter-turn industrial valves and dampers, providing years of dependable service. More than 1 million Limitorque actuators have been installed around the world — and some have been in operation for more than a half-century.
about:
Limitorque Corporation is headquartered in Lynchburg, Virginia, and traces its founding to 1929. The company began with the introduction of a torque-limiting design for electric actuators, a concept that became the standard for heavy-duty valve automation.

The company manufactures a range of actuation products including heavy-duty electric actuators, fluid power actuators, Scotch yoke pneumatic actuators, and control systems. It also provides network controls that integrate with plant systems via open-architecture digital protocols. More than one million Limitorque actuators have been installed globally, with some units remaining in service for over fifty years.

Limitorque serves the power generation, chemical processing, mining, water treatment, energy, and general industrial sectors. Its actuators drive multi-turn and quarter-turn valves and dampers in applications ranging from emergency shutdown systems to continuous process optimization.

The company emphasizes its torque-limiting heritage as a safety differentiator, noting that the design protects personnel and equipment. It also highlights SIL-rated safety capabilities, digital diagnostics, and a network of Quick Response Centers for rapid field support.
